verdict.rationale: Ardent is a hosted Postgres branching and cloning service, so asking whether it can place data or replicas in user-near regions is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions region selection, multi-region placement, or geo-distributed read replicas. Pooled connection URLs are a connection-pooling feature, not regional placement, and the read-replica mention comes from a community commenter describing their own setup, not an Ardent feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can place data or replicas in regions close to my users to keep read latency low worldwide
